description: This file defines the Polymer behavior 'PaperRippleBehavior' which manages ripple effects for UI elements, including creating, ensuring, and customizing ripple effects, and handling related properties and events.

classes.name: Polymer.PaperRippleBehavior
classes.description: A behavior that adds ripple effect functionality to Polymer elements, handling ripple creation, display, and configuration.

methods.name: _buttonStateChanged
methods.description: Ensures a ripple is available when the element gains focus.

methods.name: _downHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer or keyboard press events, ensuring ripple effect when pressed.

methods.name: ensureRipple
methods.description: Creates and appends a ripple element if not already present, optionally triggered by an event.

methods.name: getRipple
methods.description: Returns the ripple element, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: hasRipple
methods.description: Checks if the ripple element exists.

methods.name: _noinkChanged
methods.description: Updates the ripple's 'noink' property when the 'noink' attribute changes.
